bug_semantics: HAXcms ships an HTML force-download mitigation in the root .htaccess (added for CVE-2026-22704) using the case-sensitive directive `SetEnvIf Request_URI "/files/.*\.html?$" force_html_download=1` + `Header always set Content-Disposition "attachment" env=force_html_download`. HAXCMSFile.php's upload path validates extensions case-INSENSITIVELY (regex `/(jpg|...|html|md)$/i`) and writes the uploaded filename to disk verbatim (only the basename is sanitized; extension keeps original case). An uppercase `.HTML` upload passes validation, is stored verbatim under /files/, and the SetEnvIf rule fails to match, so Apache serves it as text/html and renders inline - stored XSS in the HAXcms origin, bypassing the CVE-2026-22704 mitigation. The mismatch is exploitable only once BOTH halves exist.

bug_semantics: django/db/models/sql/compiler.py order_by() compiler treated ANY field name containing a period as if it came from .extra(order_by=...) and passed 'table.column' through verbatim as RawSQL (col unquoted) - with no check that the field was actually in self.query.extra_order_by. FilteredRelation (django/db/models/query_utils.py) lets the caller choose the join alias via the annotate() keyword, and Query.table_alias() uses that user string as the literal table alias (alias = filtered_relation.alias if filtered_relation is not None else table_name). A crafted annotate alias containing a period therefore flows into ORDER BY and is re-parsed as a raw table.column pair, injecting SQL. Only FilteredRelation is exploitable in practice because other expressions are optimized to ordinal ORDER BY positions.

flaw_origin: Missing validation of user-supplied raw card button values at the channel send surface: send path trusted ctx.params.card and forwarded it to Feishu without rejecting legacy (pre-structured-interaction) command/text payloads.
reasoning: Chain: 2267d58a (2026-02-05) adds sendCardFeishu to extensions/feishu/src/send.ts for internal markdown-card use (not attacker-reachable). f4dbd78a (2026-03-14, PR #46692, human author Tak Hoffman) first exposes a channel action that forwards arbitrary user-supplied card JSON to sendCardFeishu with no button-value validation; such cards with legacy button values (command/text) mint legacy Feishu card callbacks that bypass DM pairing. BIC author/committer: Peter Steinberger <steipete@gmail.com>, single-line commit body, no Co-Authored-By/[AI] trailers.
flaw_origin: f6317fb747f5e253dcf8119a00e6b70c7add0023 (fix(gateway): stop pinning node commands to pairing state, 2026-04-01) removed diffApprovedNodeCommands/needsRepair handling from src/gateway/node-connect-reconcile.ts reconcileNodePairingOnConnect so that for paired nodes effectiveCommands = normalizeDeclaredNodeCommands(declared, allowlist) with no re-pairing when declared commands exceed the approved (paired) set
reasoning: Causal chain: pre-2026-04-01 inline message-handler.ts pinned effective commands to the paired set; db0cea5689a (2026-04-01) extracted reconciliation into node-connect-reconcile.ts with diffApprovedNodeCommands needsRepair forcing re-pairing on command drift; f6317fb747f (2026-04-01, same day) removed that drift check so a paired node reconnecting with a broader allowlisted command set got it directly as effectiveCommands with no operator/admin re-pairing - the exact vulnerability; a383878e97b (2026-04-07) restored re-pairing via hasCommandUpgrade, shipped in v2026.4.8. bug_semantics: Built-in channel setup/login resolved channel-plugin catalog entries with workspace origin (untrusted workspace channel shadows) before the plugin was explicitly trusted in config, so a malicious workspace plugin claiming a bundled channel id could be installed/enabled/executed during channel setup even while disabled.
evidence: Fix 53c29df2 (2026-04-02, mappel-nv, PR #59158) changes src/channels/plugins/catalog.ts (adds origin field + excludeWorkspace option to listChannelPluginCatalogEntries) and src/commands/channel-setup/channel-plugin-resolution.ts (adds isTrustedWorkspaceChannelCatalogEntry/resolveTrustedCatalogEntry gating on resolveEnableState). BIC 791b568f (2026-01-24, author/committer Peter Steinberger <steipete@gmail.com>, single-line subject 'feat: add tlon channel plugin', no Co-Authored-By/AI trailers) introduces the vulnerable lines: add.ts resolveCatalogChannelEntry -> listChannelPluginCatalogEntries({workspaceDir}) used by channelsAddCommand install path, and onboard-channels.ts setupChannels/collectChannelStatus switching from listChannelPluginCatalogEntries() to listChannelPluginCatalogEntries({workspaceDir}). Parent d4664231 already contained catalog ORIGIN_PRIORITY {config:0,workspace:1,global:2,bundled:3} and workspace discovery plumbing, but no setup/login caller passed workspaceDir (onboard-channels.ts lines 114/391 called it with no options; add.ts had no catalog usage), so untrusted workspace shadows were unreachable during setup. Advisory fix note: advisory cites >=2026.4.2 release; fix commit 53c29df2 verified in-tree 2026-04-02.
flaw_origin: 791b568f782550390936434b6b6d78f11540f906 wired the workspace directory into setup-time catalog resolution: added resolveCatalogChannelEntry(raw,cfg) in src/commands/channels/add.ts calling listChannelPluginCatalogEntries({workspaceDir}), and made src/commands/onboard-channels.ts collectChannelStatus/setupChannels pass {workspaceDir}. Catalog ORIGIN_PRIORITY already ranked workspace=1 above bundled=3, so an untrusted workspace plugin shadowing a bundled channel id won resolution, with no trust/enable-state check on the entry.
reasoning: Causal chain: (1) Jan 20 660f8727 refactored catalog.ts to discovery-based entries with ORIGIN_PRIORITY workspace=1 (shadows bundled=3) and discovery honoring a workspaceDir argument — but no setup caller passed it. (2) Jan 24 791b568f first passed the agent workspace dir into setup/login catalog resolution (channels add install path + onboard-channels setup flow), making an untrusted workspace plugin whose manifest.channel.id matches a bundled channel id win resolution during setup with no trust/enable-state check. (3) A malicious workspace plugin claiming a bundled channel id was thus installable/enabled/executed during channel setup while disabled. (4) Fix 53c29df2 closes it by tracking origin on catalog entries and excluding workspace entries at setup time unless the plugin is explicitly enabled in config. BIC vulnerable lines are human-authored (Peter Steinberger, no AI trailers) => NOT_AI.

bug_semantics: On Windows nodes, exec requests were executed as cmd.exe /d /s /c <rawCommand>, while allowlist/approval gating ran POSIX-only shell analysis that does not model cmd.exe metacharacters, so allowlisted or approved raw commands could chain with '&' or expand via %...% / !...! beyond the allowlisted command.
evidence: Fix a7f4a53ce80c98ba1452eb90802d447fca9bf3d6 'fix: harden Windows exec allowlist' (2026-02-03, Peter Steinberger) passes platform into analyzeShellCommand/evaluateShellAllowlist in src/infra/exec-approvals.ts, adds WINDOWS_UNSUPPORTED_TOKENS rejection for & | < > ^ ( ) % ! newlines, and makes src/node-host/runner.ts treat cmd.exe as not allowlist-safe and run parsed argv directly; advisory cites release 2026.2.2 as the verified fixed tree. BIC ae0b4c49903dbb2e44853c284882914fad2a1375 'feat: add exec host routing + node daemon' (2026-01-18 07:44:28 +0000, author=committer=Peter Steinberger <steipete@gmail.com>, body is the one-line subject, no Co-Authored-By/AI trailers) creates src/infra/node-shell.ts with buildNodeShellCommand returning ["cmd.exe","/d","/s","/c",command] for win platforms (lines 1-10) and wires it into src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts (argv = buildNodeShellCommand(params.command, nodeInfo?.platform); rawCommand: params.command sent to the node, replacing the prior ["/bin/sh","-lc",params.command]). Parent 49bd2d96fa99fe70bc02535e965febc5a5d655df has no src/infra/node-shell.ts (cat-file -e fails) and bash-tools.exec.ts:416 still builds ["/bin/sh","-lc",command] — the Windows cmd.exe raw-command surface is absent. Later hardening commits (e872f53 2026-01-23 chained allowlists; cb3290f 2026-02-14 rawCommand/argv consistency) did not model cmd.exe parsing; the flaw persisted until a7f4a53.
flaw_origin: Vulnerable raw-command execution surface introduced with the exec host routing / node daemon: buildNodeShellCommand() returns ["cmd.exe","/d","/s","/c",command] on Windows, and the exec tool sends the raw command string gated only by platform-unaware (POSIX) allowlist analysis.
reasoning: The vulnerable behavior is the combination (a) Windows execs run via cmd.exe /d /s /c <rawCommand> and (b) the allowlist/approval gating for that raw command uses POSIX shell tokenization that ignores cmd.exe metacharacters. Both halves first appear atomically in ae0b4c499 (node-shell.ts creation + bash-tools.exec.ts rawCommand wiring in the same commit); in the parent the exec path was /bin/sh -lc only, so the flaw is parent-absent. The BIC is authored and committed by Peter Steinberger with a bare subject and no AI attribution trailers on the vulnerable lines, so the flaw is human-authored.

bug_semantics: MCP stdio plugin command+args registered by an authenticated user via POST /api/cli-tools/cowork-settings customPlugins (p.command/p.args taken verbatim) are passed unvalidated to child_process.spawn(plugin.command, plugin.args) in the MCP stdio->SSE bridge, so any authenticated user can spawn arbitrary interpreters (e.g. node -e <payload>) and achieve authenticated RCE; the chain is completed by the LOCAL_ONLY gate trusting the client-supplied Host header (separate link 9ROUTER-2026-003), but the unvalidated-args sink is independently exploitable on any deployment where requireLogin=false or the SSE route is reachable.

Parent 76f3d4b7 has no src/lib/mcp/stdioSseBridge.js (cat-file -e fails on 8f4d29ca^:src/lib/mcp/stdioSseBridge.js) and no registerCustomPlugin anywhere (git log -S registerCustomPlugin across --all returns only f8b73faf and 8f4d29ca; May-7/May-9 route commits have 0 spawn refs); /api/mcp not in any LOCAL_ONLY gate at BIC. 992f4db4 (2026-05-13) later adds only a command-name allowlist (ALLOWED_MCP_COMMANDS includes node/python/bun) while args remain unvalidated — matches advisory v0.4.59 state where 'node -e <payload>' passes. Fix f8b73faf5d4da7c0753800e66f34d8267f0f3b46 (2026-06-08, 'feat(cowork): re-enable Claude Cowork with preset-only stdio MCP') deletes CUSTOM_FILE, getCustomStore, isAllowedCommand, registerCustomPlugin and disk lazy-load, leaving 'Only preset stdio plugins may spawn. No user-defined commands (RCE prevention)'; f8b73faf is an ancestor of tag v0.5.2 (advisory patched version). Audit-pair 7648c3412b403a29f04967c4b4e9725e228791d4->da667836cc7584bea0edd893de1d590c9ea279dc is the locality/Host-header link (9ROUTER-2026-003), not the MCP-args sink; RESEARCH-CAUSAL U008 scored that pair FAIL/wrong_edge and noted b282f0554972ea35281520738759d76abcd0b0b3 wrote the dangerous x-9r-real-ip locality use.
flaw_origin: The entire src/lib/mcp/stdioSseBridge.js (findPlugin/registerCustomPlugin/getOrSpawn spawn sink) and the cowork-settings customPlugins registration path were newly created in one release squash commit with zero command/argument validation; the vulnerable spawn line and custom-plugin loading are part of that same commit.
reasoning: Advisory's RCE is unvalidated MCP plugin args reaching child_process.spawn. Minimal first-writer of that behavior: 8f4d29ca (v0.4.30 release squash) created the bridge file and the customPlugins->registerCustomPlugin->spawn chain with no argument validation; the bridge and sink are absent in its parent, so the BIC is clean and atomic (no finer pre-squash commit touching the file is reachable across --all). The vulnerable lines (spawn sink + unvalidated registration) carry human author/committer decolua and no AI trailers, so AI did not author the flaw. The later fix f8b73faf (preset-only spawn) is AI-co-authored (Co-authored-by: Cursor) — AI wrote the fix, not the flaw — and the advisory's patched version v0.5.2 contains it.
